## 3. Integrity cross-check against the registry research

For each of the 27 moved packages, the `integrity` in the new lock was compared to the `dist.integrity` recorded in `M0-T185-registry-research.md` (read from the registry in round 1).

- **Matches: 27 of 27.** No mismatch. No package was unrecorded in the research. Every package the research recorded as moving is exactly the set that moved in the lock. The lock integrity therefore equals the official `registry.npmjs.org` `dist.integrity` for every moved tarball.

## 5. S5 — explicit untouched-files statement

`git diff --stat 10d6f979..HEAD` changes exactly: `apps/web/package.json`, `apps/web/package-lock.json`, `project-control/reports/M0-T185-registry-research.md`, `project-control/reports/M0-T185-producer-report.md`, and (orchestrator's own correction) `project-control/tasks/M0-T185.json`, `project-control/reports/M0-T185-G0.md`, `project-control/blockers/B-030-sharp-advisory-web-dependency-gate.json`. **Untouched:** `apps/web/.npmrc`, `apps/web/scripts/dependency_age_gate.mjs` and its tests, `docs/DEPENDENCY_SECURITY_POLICY.md`, and every file under `.github/`. **No** age exception, exclusion, allowlist, suppression or waiver of any kind was added anywhere.

## 6. What this does NOT show

- It does not show that the application behaves identically with the new image library beyond what the build and browser tests exercise. `sharp` is the native image-optimisation library used by Next.js; the functional check is S7's `web` build + `web-e2e` on the post-lock head, which the orchestrator records.
- It does not show that no later advisory will appear against `sharp@0.35.5` or the `@img` packages at their new versions. The reading was advisory-free at 2026-10-06T15:31:48 UTC; the scheduled re-audit (`scheduled-web-audit.yml`) is the continuing guard, and a future advisory reopens security work (policy §4).
- This round ran no `npm install`/`ci`/`update`; the comparison is a pure read of the two committed lockfiles. The lock was written only by the generate-lockfile workflow.
